info.title: CedarLoom local API
info.description: Answers on http://127.0.0.1:<port> only. Open the URL the server prints (#t=<token>) and send the token to POST /api/session once; every other request then needs the cookie cedarloom_session_<port> it sets and its csrf value in the x-cedarloom-csrf header.

get.description: text/event-stream: `runs` events with RunsEvent (the runs), `refusal` events with Refusal
